svg.text: Step 1 turns requirement ranks into heading weights. Step 2 multiplies each weight by the concept's 0–4 score.
no requirement in the list → minimum 1 point
no requirement in the list → minimum 1 point
no requirement in the list → minimum 1 point
points = weight × score ÷ 4 × 100, so a 4 on every heading gives 100.
Adding a column gives the concept's weighted score (the % on the matrix).
Scale (VDI 2225): 0 unsatisfactory · 1 just tolerable · 2 adequate · 3 good · 4 very good.
C04 scored as refined (dry motor, magnetic coupling, lift-out basket, crank backup).
